description: Six proposed Constitution Trail branch segments that the native app can show as an opt-in preview. They are not in the CC BY 4.0 licensed McGIS open-data item the web ships, and no explicit redistribution grant has been found. This manifest holds NO geometry: it lists which segments may be admitted and the SHA-256 of each reviewed geometry, so that granting rights later is a matter of filling in the rights block, not of re-reviewing the data.

rights.blocker: The McGIS app and map metadata carry blank licenseInfo and name McGIS and its members as copyright holders without an explicit redistribution grant. This is an unresolved licensing basis, not a determination that redistribution is forbidden. Ask the county GIS owner for a written grant (basis, who granted it, the licence and its link), record its URL and SHA-256 here, set status to granted, and run npm run package:dataset -- --proposed-trails.
rights.recordedIn: docs/web/data-rights.md (Six proposed segments: unresolved release gate)
